children.name: get_or_create_current_user
children.comment:
Return the current User for this request, creating the row if needed.

Resolution order:
    1. ``display_name`` keyword argument if provided.
    2. ``X-User-Name`` request header.
    3. ``current_user`` field in a JSON request body.
    4. ``DEFAULT_USER_NAME`` environment variable (default: ``dev``).

The helper opens its own short database transaction so callers can use the
returned ``User`` in a larger transaction without worrying about user-row
creation races.

children.name: _extract_display_name
children.comment: Resolve display name from request header or JSON payload.

children.name: _get_or_create_user
children.comment:
Lookup or create a user by case-insensitive display_name.

Handles the small race where two requests arrive for the same new name
at the same time.

children.comment: Validate and normalize a list of manual line-item dicts.

children.name: _optional_str
children.comment: Coerce an optional string value, treating blank input as the default.

children.name: compute_profit
children.comment:
Data!D7: =ROUNDUP(D6-(IF(D6<1000,D6*0.4,D6*0.27)+Inventory!E1),0)

D6 is working_net_each (already computed by the pricing engine).
TODO: Inventory!E1 is a large per-quote allocated component cost lookup
(~130 accessory/rod-hardware/seal categories keyed off accessory
quantities, special parts, rod diameter, series, and Y/N options) that
has not been reverse-engineered/wired in yet, so it is treated as $0.

children.name: _calculate_dimensions
children.comment: Return cylinder dimensions from the authoritative Python lookup table.

children.name: generate_quote_number
children.comment:
Generate a quote ID only when a quote is being created/saved.

Format: [first letter of customer name] + MMDDYYHHMM
Example: customer "AC Hotels" at 08/19/2026 12:15 PM -> A0819261215

Generation happens at call time (create/save), not on page load. If two
quotes for the same customer land in the same minute, uniqueness is kept
by advancing one minute and retrying.

children.name: _customer_initial
children.comment: Uppercase first letter of the customer name; fallback X if missing.

children.name: parse_dimension
children.comment: Parse numeric values and Excel-style mixed fractions such as 1 3/8".

children.name: _legacy_ungated_modifications
children.comment: Charges produced by legacy formulas that do not test Data!B3 series.

children.name: _accessory_bucket
children.comment: Reproduce Acc!T5:T12 series/bore/mount bucket selection.

children.name: excel_roundup
children.comment: Excel-compatible ROUNDUP for non-negative pricing inputs.

children.name: get_cylinder_dimensions
children.comment:
Return cylinder dimensions for a given series family, bore, and stroke.

Args:
    series_family (str): Series family identifier (e.g. "H" or "A").
    bore (int/float/str/Decimal): Exact bore size to look up.
    stroke (int/float/str/Decimal): Cylinder stroke used to compute ``lb``.

Returns:
    dict: Keys are ``e``, ``g``, ``j``, ``lb``, ``f``, ``r``, ``fb``,
    ``tf``. Values are Decimal or None for fields still awaiting data.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the series family is unknown or the bore is not found.

children.name: _to_decimal
children.comment: Convert int/float/str/Decimal to Decimal safely.
